messages:
Noah Kim: Quick thread: compact "usage & billing" canvas — we're debating export affordance vs keeping density. mock: https://redwood.app/design/1876543210.png
Priya Desai: TL;DR: accountants want per-row exports. PMs want a cleaner header. I think a tiny inline affordance + bulk header option is the compromise. :balance_scale:
Oliver Grant: inline icon only on hover/focus could work. keyboard users need a persistent tab stop though (can't rely on hover).
Ava Romero: accessibility checklist: 1) aria-label must include scope (org/project) + period; 2) expanded token views must announce when they open; 3) focus trap avoided for simple actions.
Noah Kim: hybrid idea: show a subtle download icon in the row (visually-hidden until focus/hover for mouse users) + a sticky selection toolbar that appears when rows selected with "Export invoices (selected)" and "Export all (filtered)" CTAs.
Priya Desai: microcopy: row -> "Download invoice (PDF)"; toolbar -> "Export invoices (selected)". also add sr-only: "Invoice for <Org> — <Project> — <Month Year>"
Oliver Grant: implementation caveat: virtualized list + per-row elements = perf risk. we should use event delegation and only render visible action nodes. delegate handler attached at list root.
Ava Romero: token breakdown: inline collapse vs ephemeral popover. Inline collapse is friendlier for keyboard/vo users; popover keeps vertical real estate. If popover, manage focus and provide a clear heading.
DesignBot: Proposal created: /ab-test create "export-affordance-compact" variants=[A_row_primary,B_toolbar_primary,C_hybrid] duration=10d metrics=[download_rate,keyboard_download_pct,support_tickets] link: https://redwood.app/experiments/exp_765
Noah Kim: small UI detail: if we show filetype in CTA (PDF/CSV) add it in the visible label for clarity. e.g., "Download invoice (PDF)" rather than generic "Download".
Priya Desai: agree. also include a keyboard shortcut hint in the bulk toolbar like "(Shift+D)" for power users — behind toggle in settings.
Oliver Grant: ARIA example for row button: ```html
<button aria-label="Download invoice for Acme Co — Payments — Apr 2026 (PDF)" data-row-id="inv_2026_04_123">⬇️</button>
``` Keep visible icon only, full context in aria-label + sr-only text.
Ava Romero: acceptance criteria for prototype: 1) keyboard-only users can discover and download single invoice; 2) screen reader announces scope & period; 3) no >10% regression in render times at 95th percentile; 4) usability test with 6 non-power users for discoverability.
Noah Kim: dev follow-ups: Oliver to spike delegated handler + lazy-load token details, Priya to update copy + Figma frames for A/B variants, Ava to author ARIA snippets. I'll coordinate the experiment tracking.
Priya Desai: I'll post updated frames by EOD with both inline-collapse and popover variants and microcopy.
Oliver Grant: I'll put up a perf spike branch and include a small e2e keyboard test for download flows.
Ava Romero: I'll draft final aria copy and a short screen-reader script we can use in the usability sessions.
DesignBot: Reminder: AB test will auto-terminate if keyboard_download_pct < 2% for any variant after day 3.
